jobs.description:
TL;DR: We're looking for someone exceptional for a career-defining chapter at Lovable.
You will take everything that isn't building Lovable off Anton Osika's plate, and run it so well he never has to think about it again - his calendar, his travel, his inbox, his life. Things just get done.
This is a full-time, in-office role in Stockholm, moving at the rapid pace of a hypergrowth company at the frontier of AI. You'll report to Emily Lincoln-Gordon, our Chief of Staff, and be a force multiplier for Lovable's Founder & CEO, Anton Osika.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
You've run a demanding principal's life before - whether as an EA, or another operational role that was just as intense - and the results speak for themselves.
You're the person people trust with the things that matter most, and you never drop the ball.
AI is already how you work - you reach for it by default.
Exceptional English. Swedish is a bonus, not a requirement.
You're energised by pace, change, and are at your best when context switching frequently - few roles will vary this much, day to day. Just as few will be as big an adventure, or as much fun, as this role.

What you’ll do
Own the calendar, travel, and inbox end to end - anticipating what Anton needs before he asks.
Be the first person investors, partners, and guests meet.
Handle the personal alongside the professional - nothing's off-limits if it needs doing.
Use AI to build leverage for both of you, not just to keep pace with the reactive work.

Our process
We move quickly and default to transparency. Here's what to expect from our process:
Recruiter intro chat
Async technical exercise brief shared with you (time investment: ~45-60 minutes)
Hiring Manager Interview with Emily, our Chief of Staff (to discuss your exercise, and get to know you and tell you a bit about us and the role)
Interview with Anton, our CEO
A final in-office session in Stockholm with the wider Office of CEO team, including lunch

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Vi tror att detta beror på vår tydliga ethos, med engagerade och synliga ledare som skapar en miljö där lärare kan undervisa och elever kan lära. IES-skolorna har en dynamisk, internationell atmosfär med personal och elever från hela världen. Våra skolor är öppna för alla och antagning sker i turordning utifrån ködatum.

Om Internationella Engelska Skolan Kista

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Kista är en del av Sveriges största och mest framgångsrika nätverk av tvåspråkiga skolor, med undervisning för elever i årskurserna F–9. IES Kista har 640 elever och 79 medarbetare. Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och upp till 50 % av undervisningen sker på engelska.

På IES Kista tror vi på höga akademiska förväntningar, tvåspråkig undervisning (engelska och svenska) och ömsesidig respekt mellan elever och personal. Vi strävar efter att ge varje elev kunskap, självförtroende och en stark känsla av ansvar för att förbereda dem för framtida framgångar.

Vår skola är en gemenskap av yrkesverksamma och oavsett om du är ny i läraryrket eller en erfaren pedagog får du möjlighet att utvecklas hos oss.

Vi söker nu en behörig tysklärare för årskurs 8–9.

Om tjänsten:

Som lärare i tyska på IES Kista kommer du att:

- Undervisa i tyska för elever i årskurs 8–9 i enlighet med den svenska läroplanen (Lgr22)
- Vara kunnig och brinna för ditt ämne
- Vara en ledare i klassrummet med verktyg för att skapa en trygg och studierik arbetsmiljö
- Planera, genomföra och bedöma engagerande och välstrukturerade lektioner
- Anpassa och differentiera din undervisning utifrån elevernas olika behov och nivåer
- Samarbeta med kollegor inom ämnesgruppen för moderna språk och i övriga arbetslag
- Bidra till skolans positiva och internationella atmosfär

Tjänsten är en deltidsanställning på 30 %, där du undervisar en undervisningsgrupp i årskurs 8 och en i årskurs 9.

Kvalifikationer:

- Lärarexamen och lärarlegitimation i tyska för årskurs 7–9
- Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga på både engelska och svenska
- Erfarenhet av undervisning i en internationell eller tvåspråkig miljö är meriterande
- Ett strukturerat, engagerat och professionellt förhållningssätt till undervisning och samarbete

För att ansöka skickar du in ditt CV, personliga brev samt ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete inom skola. Rekrytering sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan!

Sinch Telco is a standalone business within Sinch. Our products support communications services for mobile operators around the globe. Our systems are backend systems that communicate with other backend systems. You will not find them on Sinch's public website. We are protocol heavy and regard USSD, SMPP, Diameter, and SIP as about as much frontend it gets in our domain. We are looking for an experienced software engineer with focus on AI-driven Development, to further accelerate adoption of AI-powered development practices across Sinch Telco.

In this role, you’ll be a hands-on practitioner, leveraging AI agents to design, build, verify and deliver our type of software while shaping how AI is applied in our software development. Together we move toward a paradigm where software developers manage teams of specialized AI agents for requirements analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, and deployment. We intend to unlock new capabilities that enable teams to build and ship faster with higher quality, security, and maintainability.

You have a vision for the future of AI-driven software development but understand that progress requires practical steps and patience. You demonstrate value through hands-on work and tangible results. You collaborate well with experienced colleagues as a peer and respect existing domain knowledge while contributing new perspectives and influence through the quality of your work. You are self-directed, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity. The AI tooling landscape changes rapidly and you are energized by this pace.
As our Software Engineer, you will:
Work in a team as a highly productive, hands-on software engineer, leveraging agents to deliver features and products across multiple areas.
Lead by example to spread best practices, workflows, and tooling for AI-assisted development for coding, testing, documentation, and deployment.
Assist in evaluation, selection, and configuration of AI development tools and agent frameworks to improve software development.
Define clear requirements and product direction with a product management perspective in cooperation with product managers and team members. 

REQUIREMENTS
Extensive software engineering experience, with a proven ability to design, evaluate, and evolve software architectures.
Solid understanding of complex distributed backend systems. Experience with telecom systems, BSS/OSS, or messaging infrastructure is a plus.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, for production software delivery, not just experimentation.
Experience working with AI-driven development workflows, including autonomous coding agents and multistep task orchestration.
Ability to define clear, structured, and decomposable requirements for both engineers and AI agents, with strong product awareness and long-term stability.
Practical experience with Model Context Protocol. Experience with multi-agent frameworks is a plus.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts, document approaches, and collaborate effectively across teams.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
We are not supporting relocation at this time. Applicants must either hold a Swedish or EU/EEA citizenship or have a valid Swedish work permit.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive.
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology develops autonomous robots for field use and has tested them in mines and other underground environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop autonomy for teams of legged, wheeled and aerial robots in places with extended risk, such as underground mines and areas prone to rockfall. The work covers scene understanding with foundation models, navigation, and coordinated decisions within the robot team when communication is limited. 
 
Subject description
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
  
Project description
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics.
 
Autonomous robots deployment in underground mines, areas prone to rockfall and other environments that are dangerous for people often need several robots working together. Communication between the robots is often intermittent, and each robot must interpret its surroundings well enough to judge risk on its own. Vision and language foundation models can support this kind of interpretation, but they rarely model the physics of the terrain or the dynamics of the robot. This position will develop methods that connect scene understanding, physics-informed navigation and coordination within the robot team, and validate them in real environments.
  
The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.
 
- Scene and context understanding with foundation models, for example vision-language models, in underground mines and areas prone to rockfall, including hazard identification and risk-aware traversability assessment
 
- Physics-informed foundation models for autonomous navigation, where learned models account for the robot's dynamics and the physical properties of the terrain
 
- Multi-robot collaboration over mesh networks, with shared mapping and coordinated decision making under intermittent communication
 
- Communication-aware planning of multi-robot missions that use 5G/6G infrastructure, where the robots plan their motion and tasks based on network coverage and capacity
 
- Experimental validation on legged, wheeled and aerial robots in underground and mining environments
 
Duties
The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real robots and field experiments in mines and other underground environments. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.
 
Qualifications
To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.
 
You need a good knowledge of at least one of the following: robot perception, learning-based methods for robotics, multi-robot systems, or motion and mission planning. Previous work with experimentally verified results on real robots, in at least one of the research areas above, is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python, and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.
 
Experience of foundation models or vision-language models in robotics, of legged robots, of communication and mesh networking for robots, of wireless communication systems such as 5G or 6G, or of field experiments in underground environments is a merit.
 
Further information
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.
 
For further information about the position, please contact
 
Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se 
 
Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

Also include a research plan of at most two pages that describes how you would approach one or more of the research areas above, and the names and contact details of two references. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology works in field robotics and tests its methods on robots in real environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop sensing and autonomy for drones that inspect infrastructure and terrain in Arctic environments such as Greenland, where the flights take place in severe cold. You will work on sensor systems that withstand the arctic cold and, on the localisation, mapping and mission planning methods that depend on them. We value good collaboration skills and an interest in field work in cold climates.
Subject description
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
Project description
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics as well as http://www.fieldrobotics.eu
Drones make it possible to inspect infrastructure and terrain in the Arctic without sending people into dangerous conditions, but the cold affects the hardware the drones depend on. Batteries lose capacity, ice forms on lenses and propellers, and lidar and cameras return degraded data in blowing snow, fog and low sun. At high magnetic latitudes, magnetometers become unreliable for heading, and GNSS reception can be limited in fjords and steep terrain. This position will develop sensing and autonomy that work under these conditions, with drone inspection in environments such as Greenland as the main application.
The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.
Design, characterisation and calibration of cold-hardened sensor payloads for drones, for example lidar, radar, thermal cameras, event cameras and inertial sensors
Multi-sensor state estimation and mapping that accounts for degraded sensor data, for example in snow, fog, low-texture scenes and with unreliable GNSS or magnetometer data
Sensor health monitoring and fault detection, so that the autonomy systems can detect when a sensor can no longer be trusted and adapt to it
Energy- and weather-aware mission planning for inspection flights that accounts for battery behaviour in the cold and for wind
Autonomous inspection of infrastructure and terrain in Arctic settings, with field experiments in cold climates, for example in Greenland and northern Sweden

Duties
The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real drones and field experiments in cold climates that involve travel. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.
Qualifications
To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.
You need a good knowledge of state estimation, sensor fusion or robot perception, and documented experience of experimental work with drones. Previous work with experimentally verified results in at least one of the research areas above is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.
Experience of sensor integration and drone hardware, of perception with lidar, radar or thermal cameras, of field experiments in cold or harsh environments, or of autonomous inspection missions is a merit.
Further information
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.
